title: Connectives toolkit card
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 18 (Connectives toolkit card (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 18: Connectives for longer answers. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

model.title: Link: I like science. It is hard. I study it every day.

parts.text: بِالإِضَافَةِ إِلَى ذٰلِكَ، أَقْرَأُ كُتُبًا عَنِ الفَضَاءِ

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: أُحِبُّ العُلُومَ لٰكِنَّهَا صَعْبَةٌ، لِذٰلِكَ أَدْرُسُهَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ. بِالإِضَافَةِ إِلَى ذٰلِكَ، أَقْرَأُ كُتُبًا عَنِ الفَضَاءِ.

head: Not this
This
rows: لٰكِنَّهَا صَعْبَةٌ: لٰكِنَّ needs a noun or attached pronoun after it

questions.q: Link with لِذٰلِكَ: الحَاسُوبُ مُفِيدٌ. أَدْرُسُهُ.
Link with لٰكِنَّ: التَّارِيخُ مُمْتِعٌ. هُوَ طَوِيلٌ.
Core: Write a paragraph of 5 sentences about your subjects using at least four different connectives (portal response box).
questions.a: For example: أُحِبُّ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ لِأَنَّهَا لُغَةُ القُرْآنِ. الرِّيَاضِيَّاتُ مُهِمَّةٌ لٰكِنَّهَا صَعْبَةٌ، لِذٰلِكَ أَتَدَرَّبُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ. أُحِبُّ العُلُومَ أَيْضًا. بِالإِضَافَةِ إِلَى ذٰلِكَ، أَدْرُسُ الحَاسُوبَ.

questions.q: Extend: Swap a partner's paragraph in a breakout room and underline every connective; suggest one more.
questions.a: Peer feedback with one EBI (even better if) suggestion

questions.q: Stretch: Rewrite your paragraph for a friend's school ('his/her subjects') with ـهُ / ـهَا.
questions.a: For example: يُحِبُّ أَخِي العُلُومَ لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعَةٌ، لٰكِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ التَّارِيخَ.

questions.q: 'However' is: A) مَعَ ذٰلِكَ B) لِذٰلِكَ C) ثُمَّ
Big question: how do connectives make a stronger paragraph?
questions.a: They link ideas: adding, contrasting, giving reasons and results.
